prompt: Our senior engineering team works 8+ hours daily at their Linux (Ubuntu) desktops and is experiencing eye strain, lower back stiffness, and wrist fatigue. IT has asked us to deploy an automated health reminder system. Please generate a production-ready Linux automation script named `ergocare_pro.sh` for the heavy-user profile. The script must cover all three health areas (eye health, spinal health, and RSI/wrist prevention), use all available notification methods, enable sound alerts, and run silently as a background process with continuous automated reminders. The script should be ready to deploy to the engineering floor immediately.
